effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 blue Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] When you play a blue Tamer, unsuspend this Digimon.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. For every blue Tamer you have in play, add 1 to the maximum level of the Digimon you can choose with this effect.
